go_to_stage_2_only_if_all: The planned 108-row denominator is complete or every missing row is explicitly accounted for as failed, invalid, errored, data_unavailable, or blocked.
At least one ATR-stop multiplier slice has median drawdown <= 0.35 across its 36 risk-managed rows.
The same ATR-stop multiplier slice has worst-row drawdown < 0.50.
The same ATR-stop multiplier slice improves median drawdown by at least 0.20 absolute versus the same-window no-ATR comparison slice for matching signal cells.
The same ATR-stop multiplier slice has positive median net return.
At least 4 rows in the same ATR-stop multiplier slice have positive net return.
The positive effect appears across at least two funding_lookback_bars values and both entry tail pairs.
No single isolated parameter cell is the only evidence for continuation.
Real-runner reconciliation does not materially contradict any vectorbt sidecar preview.
Funding-PnL/accounting changes are not required to interpret the result.
no_go_if_any: The denominator is incomplete or winner-only reporting occurs.
All ATR-stop multiplier slices have median drawdown > 0.35 or worst-row drawdown >= 0.50.
Drawdown improves only because returns are killed, defined as non-positive median net return for every ATR-stop multiplier slice.
Only one isolated row passes the net-return and drawdown thresholds.
The apparent effect is confined to one funding lookback or one entry tail pair.
Vectorbt and real-runner results materially diverge and the divergence is not resolved before decision.
The run requires funding payment/accounting changes, runtime/paper/live paths, or protected OMS/risk/reconciliation/order/exchange paths.
The Stage 1 output writes canonical evidence or candidate lifecycle records without later explicit authorization.

material_divergence_definition.return_direction_mismatch: matching variant has opposite net-return sign between sidecar and real runner
material_divergence_definition.drawdown_bucket_mismatch: matching variant differs across <=0.35, 0.35-0.50, >0.50 drawdown buckets
material_divergence_definition.trade_count_order_mismatch: matching variant differs by more than 2x trade count without explained semantic reason
material_divergence_definition.missing_matching_variant: variant present in one engine output and absent from the other without denominator accounting

no_go_reasons: all ATR slices have median drawdown > 35% or worst-row drawdown >= 50%
drawdown improves only with non-positive median net return for every ATR slice
real_runner_reconciliation_note: real-runner-only; no vectorbt sidecar used in this package
